candidate_features.microbiome: All genera passing train-fold prevalence filtering; tumor, adjacent-normal, mean and paired-difference representations are computed within each training fold.
candidate_features.expanded_measured: ICR score is evaluated separately because it requires tumor RNA measurement and is not available from routine web inputs.

reference_only_features: Published AC-ICAM MBR score and its 41 selected genera
forbidden_features: published MBR group in candidate models
outcome-selected MRS genera in candidate models

evaluation.inner_cv: stratified 3-fold CV on outer-train patients only
evaluation.confidence_interval: patient bootstrap on pooled out-of-fold predictions
evaluation.selection_rule: All filtering, transforms, supervised feature selection, model tuning and blend-weight selection are fit inside the outer training fold.

claim_boundary: V8 uses real outcomes and measured tissue microbiome from a colon-cancer cohort. It is not directly comparable with the synthetic/noisy V7 score and it does not validate saliva or stool deployment.
